action_label: Review the Shopify orders that synced in
description:
Orders are stored verbatim, every cart attribute and line-item property kept, and they are the source of truth — **no Sales Order and no Quotation is created**.

A prepaid "3 boxes over 3 months" order carries its duration and start date as attributes; anything longer than one delivery also creates a **Shopify Subscription** plus one allocation per delivery.
